page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal references in the right margin, beside the lines "eo sensu, non", "licit, id pro" and "corpora". Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Catchword "pium," at the right below the last line, signature "G 2" at the left below the text.

main_text.p: clariorem cognitionem veritatis, hic quod maxime pium & honestum est agit. Qua fronte igitur scribit, exemplum illud à Cartesio non esse adhibitum, quando de dubiis pro falso habendis est locutus? agnosce ista verba & erubesce. Tenet ipsum hujus conscientia, metuque correptus, sequentibus verbis latebras quaerit, eo sensu quem fingit adversarius: eo sensu, nonEpist. Lib. ii. Ep. x. licit, id pro falso habendum Cartesius. Quis tandem ille sensus? eo sensu, quo caelum non esse, corpora non esse supponit. Vide locum quem citavi & patet. Eo sensu, misera cavillatio, eo sensu, quo difficile, quo laboriosum, quo periculosum, quo semel licitum est, ex Cartesii & tua hypothesi: Si ille bonus & utilis[?]ve; periculosum define, semel licitum, laboriosum esse vociferari define. Ista autem non lubet hac occasione prosequi ulterius. Non soli Peripatetici, non soli Scholastici, distinctionibus evadunt. 8. Dum sensuum fides ita vacillat, imo pro nulla habetur, unde fidei erit certitudo, dum nec auribus fidis, nec oculis, quid verbum, quid Sacramenta revelabunt, significabunt? 9. Haec conditio thesin tuam evertit necessario, vis dubitare de existentia rerum corpora-rum, idque data opera, serio & obstinate in ea meditatione defixus; omnium opinionum vacas eversioni: [?]que ex fide, quam sartam rectamque fingis, interim corpora esse, existere, creata esse, constat. Tandem subvertit haec exceptio, quintam. Dubitatio enim si talis assensus solum cohibitio sit, cer-te[?], aut in rebus fidei temere agendum erit, iisque antequam de earum certitudine clare quicquam constet, as[?]sentiendum, aut à dubitatione non removendae.
Tertiam sic refuto 1. Si vera est prima exceptio, ista necessario falsa est, Sceptici enim æque de principiis, æque notionibus simplicibus dubitant ac de reliquis.

page.notes: Left edge: partial letters of the neighbouring page's text are visible and were not transcribed. Doubtful readings: the word after "Si ille bonus &" is partly hidden by the left edge (utilisve assumed); the word "quid" at the start of the last full line is cut by the edge; the first word of the line after "pium" is cut ("[?]que", assumed to be a word ending in -que); "cer-te" continuation is partly hidden; "sentiendum" has a hidden prefix (assumed "assentiendum"); the paragraph break before "Tertiam" and before "Ridicula" is uncertain from the indent. The marginal references are printed as three lines; they are given as one note. A small stray mark appears between "sartam" and "rectamque" and is not transcribed. Printed "define" for "desine" is kept as printed.
